## Type

- [ ] Vendor notices document (`catalog/notices.yaml`)
- [ ] Sourced statement(s) (`community/assertions.csv`)
- [ ] SBOM (`community/sboms/`)
- [ ] Watchlist, alias or provider change (`catalog/`)
- [ ] Code or site change

## Checklist

- [ ] Every statement, document or SBOM links to public evidence, or (for binary scans) names the artifact and its SHA-256
- [ ] I'm permitted to share this information, and it contains nothing confidential
- [ ] It's about a commercial or closed-source **product**, not an open source package
- [ ] `python -m xenolith community --check` passes locally
- [ ] Notes are in my own words
